notes: QA audit batch 5 (v1.11.28): ten Low bugs (BUG-040–049). BUG-040: a forgotten running timer no longer banks unlimited time — on load, a running timer older than 4 hours (or 2× its box's planned length, whichever is smaller) is paused at that cap and the user is asked whether to resume it or stop it (banking the capped time). BUG-041: the done-pull now counts boxes skipped because a local tick is still pending — the count is in the sync summary (done_skipped_pending) and the sync log, so a stuck push is visible instead of looking like «in sync». BUG-042: feed-freshness guard — a pull that would orphan 3+ boxes and more than half of the mapped in-span boxes (or 5+ outright) is treated as a suspicious feed: adds/updates still apply, but no link is dropped and no box is flagged; the same boxes missing on two consecutive pulls confirm genuine deletions and the orphaning applies. BUG-043: SSRF guard — every server-side fetch resolves the destination host first and rejects private/loopback/link-local addresses, on the initial URL and on every redirect hop (legitimate public hosts — Google ICS, raw.githubusercontent.com, Gemini — are unaffected). BUG-044: the remaining unescaped box/topic identifiers in attribute contexts and selector strings are escaped (or selected by class/dataset instead). BUG-045: concurrent OAuth flows keep their own state/verifier in a map keyed by state (legacy singleton migrated once) — a second rapid «connect» click no longer breaks the first flow. BUG-046: the Gemini key is sent in the x-goog-api-key header, never as ?key= (generateContent and the model list alike); the key-status endpoint returns only a boolean — no masked form leaks key characters. BUG-047: the server banner is now just «StudyFlow» (no Python version) and every response carries X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY and a basic CSP. BUG-048: at most 10 request threads run at once (extra requests get 503 after 30 s) and Gemini calls are capped at 20 per minute. BUG-049: dashboard/box-card/calendar durations now use Persian digits (fmtDurationFa); Analytics keeps Western digits exactly as verify1122 pins them, and the dead jalaliText helper uses Persian day digits too. Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced). The 1.11.18 examDateText live-computation fix and the 1.11.27 delete-retry fix are untouched.
